notes: Official Shopify store chhedas.com (chhedaspecialities.com redirects there). MRPs are from BigBasket listings (bigbasket.com/pb/chhedas/, read Oct 2026), not the brand site: chhedas.com shows only a 'Regular price' (not labelled MRP) and it is often below BigBasket's MRP (e.g. Long Masala ₹89 vs MRP ₹95), so it was not used as MRP. Pack names on chhedas.com and BigBasket differ slightly (e.g. 'Salt N Pepper' vs 'Salt & Pepper'). Veg = page shows '100% VEGETARIAN'. Some chhedas.com pack shots sit on a beige background rather than pure white (noted per product). Note: Chheda's is a Mumbai brand, not Indori.

company: Jai Jalaram Food Products (pack label: 'Jalaram Biscuits'), Plot No. 82, Ahmednagar Industrial Estate, Nagar–Pune Road, Kedgaon, Ahmednagar 414005, Maharashtra; since 1997
notes: Several businesses use the 'Jalaram' name: 'Jalaram' on BigBasket (mukhwas, papad, dates), Jalaram Foods in Mulund, Mumbai (fresh farsan), Jay Shree Jalaram (Bardoli patra), and Jai Jalaram Food in Valsad (gunda pickle). Picked Jai Jalaram Food Products because it is a packaged, branded brand that calls itself 'Maharashtra's First 100% Pure Veg Bakery Brand'. It makes khari, toast, cookies, cream rolls and khakhra, and its factory is on the Nagar–Pune Road, near Pune. That makes it the one most likely stocked by a Hadapsar shop. Not confirmed with the shop owner: please check against a pack in the shop. This is a bakery brand, not a namkeen brand. Not found on BigBasket or Amazon.in. Every price comes from jaijalaramfoods.com, which labels it 'Regular price', not MRP, so mrp is null except where the MRP is printed on a pack label shown on the official site. Several pack shots are brand-made 3D mockups on white background and may show a different pack size than the one now sold (noted per product). Veg = site says '100% Pure Veg Bakery' on every product page.
